scenarios.name: index-template-review
scenarios.description: Making an index template needs the user's review: the template is shown and confirmation asked for, not created in the same turn.
scenarios.prompt: Create an Elasticsearch index template for the WINDOWS-EVENTS feed's events.

scenarios.name: pipeline-feeds
scenarios.description: Which feeds the attached pipeline processes, from its processor filter.
scenarios.prompt: Which feeds does this pipeline process?

scenarios.name: cluster-failures
scenarios.description: What is failing across the cluster, from the processor tasks of every node.

scenarios.name: search-results-capped
scenarios.description: Why search results are capped, from the system property set in the database.
scenarios.prompt: Why are the results in new dashboard tables capped at 500 rows?

scenarios.name: searches-running
scenarios.description: How many searches users are running, from the server tasks of every node.
scenarios.prompt: How many searches are users running right now?

scenarios.name: dashboard-table-change
scenarios.description: A change to the attached dashboard's table is proposed with a button, not made.
scenarios.prompt: Change the Events table to count events per user, with the busiest users first.

scenarios.name: stroomql-query
scenarios.description: A question answered by running a StroomQL query against the index.
scenarios.prompt: Using StroomQL, count the events in the Events index by user over the last day.

scenarios.name: missing-permission
scenarios.description: Asking for something the user lacks the permission for: the agent says which permission is needed and invents no value.
scenarios.prompt: What is the value of the stroom.search.resultStore.maxSortedItems property?
